C: Messaging (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to access and perform different Messaging functions in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| Messages The Messages tab is where all messages are accessed. Select Messages to see a list of your existing messages, or to start a new one. Along the left side of the Messages are icons that designate message status.  ![][image1] | ![][image2] |
| ----- | :---: |
| **Composing a Message** To start a new conversation: Select the **New Message** icon in the bottom right corner. To find the person you wish to reach, you can use **Search, Pinned Contacts, My Favorites, Local Groups,** or **Recently Contacted** to quickly find your desired recipient. To **Search**, type the name of the person or broadcast group you wish to reach in the Search bar. Search results update automatically as you type. | ![][image3]  |
| **Composing a Message Continued** **Select** the message type you need to display the message template. Message fields will change based on the template selected. Select **Attach** to attach photos to your message, **Record** to attach a voice memo, and **Options** to access the message options. **Attach** \= Access your phone’s camera to take and attach a picture. You can also select to attach an existing photo from your phone’s photo library. Images will not save on the phone and are stored on PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration’s secure platform to ensure HIPAA. **Record** \= Record and send an audio message. Audio messages will not save on the phone and are stored on the secure platform to ensure HIPAA. **Options** \= Display message options such as allow replies or reply notifications to toggle them on/off if available. When finished, click **Send**. At the top of the message, you will find the date and time you sent the message. At the bottom, you will find the Sent/Read status of your message.  | ![][image4] ![][image5] |
| **Responding to Messages** Select the conversation you wish to respond to in your Messages. To reply via text, tap the **Type a message** field to start typing your message. When finished, press **Send.** **Camera** \= Access your phone’s camera to take and attach a picture. **Photo** \= Access your phone’s library to attach a saved picture. **Record** \= Record and send an audio message. **Quick Response** \= Select a templated quick response message to send. To reply via a call, press the blue phone icon next to the sender’s name and select **Call**.  | ![][image6] ![][image7] |
| **Marking a Single Message As Done** When you no longer need the message to be active in the Inbox tab of your Messages, you can now archive them to the **Done** tab of your Messages. From the main Messages tab, swipe the message to the **LEFT**; select **Done**. Inside the message, select the **three ellipses** in the upper-right corner; select **Mark as Done**. | ![][image8] ![][image9] |
| **Marking Multiple Messages As Done** Select the **Mark as Done** icon. Mark the read message threads in your inbox. Click the **Mark as Done** icon to move the selected messages to your Done folder. | ![][image10] |
| **Marking All Messages As Done** Select the **Mark as Done** icon. Click **Select all** threads to select ALL read messages threads, up to 1000, in your inbox. Click the **Mark as Done** icon to move the selected messages to your Done folder. | ![][image11] |
| **Done Folder** All messages marked as done can be found in the **Done** tab of your Messages. \***Note**: A message must be read before it can be marked as done. | ![][image12] |
| **Important Things to Know** When using the **Mark as Done** feature, keep the following in mind: **Message Must Be Read First** \- Only **read** message threads can be marked as done. Unread threads will remain in your inbox, even when using bulk actions. **Bulk Marking Limit** – Users can mark up to **1,000 read threads** as done at once, making it easier to manage large inboxes. **Search and Refine Before Bulk Actions** – Clinicians can use the **Search** function to filter their inbox and then apply Select All box to mark all read threads in the refined list as done. **Bulk Mark Done vs Bulk Mark as Read** – The Bulk Mark as Done feature is **not** the same as marking messages as read. Currently, there is no option to manually mark messages a read –messages must be opened and viewed to be considered as read. When using the bulk action, only read threads will be marked as done; any unread threads will be skipped. |  |
